visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with glasses, wearing a black shirt, is framed in a medium shot against a night city skyline background where the Taipei 101 tower is prominently illuminated. He speaks directly to the camera with high energy, using frequent hand gestures. (2) A CGI image of a Tyrannosaurus Rex head appears on the left half of the screen, covering part of the city background. The man's hands are still visible gesturing at the bottom. (3) The dinosaur image disappears, and the man continues his presentation in the center of the frame, moving his hands to emphasize points. (4) An image of a woman in a lab coat looking distressed with her hand on her head is overlaid on the screen briefly, representing a 'frustrated scientist.' (5) The view returns to the man in the studio setting. He uses expansive hand movements to describe genetic sequencing concepts. (6) A side-by-side graphic appears showing a T-Rex next to a brown leather luxury handbag, illustrating the topic of 'dinosaur leather.' (7) The man concludes his talk, gesturing more emphatically and eventually pointing both index fingers downward toward the bottom of the frame where call-to-action text appears.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Variety]: 暴龍皮包要來了? 專家卻發冷水. [Subtitle]: 最潮的皮包即將問世. (2) [Subtitle]: 不是 LV 不是愛馬仕. (3) [Subtitle]: 是暴龍. (4) [Subtitle]: 欸對 你沒聽錯 最近真的有美國公司宣佈 他們要用暴龍皮革做精品包. (5) [Subtitle]: 沒在開玩笑 他們是真的打算賣給你 讓你拎出門的那一種. (6) [Subtitle]: 他們的說法是 他們可以從暴龍化石中找到的一點點膠原蛋白碎片. (7) [Subtitle]: 去「猜」出整條膠原蛋白長什麼樣子 再讓現代細胞照著這個配方 長出類似的膠原蛋白. (8) [Subtitle]: 簡單說就是自己腦補暴龍的基因出來用. (9) [Subtitle]: 欸等等 這到底算不算暴龍啊. (10) [Subtitle]: 古生物學家超傻眼 因為要做真正的暴龍皮革包 需要 DNA 但恐龍滅絕超過 6000 萬年了 DNA 早就碎成渣 根本不可能復原. (11) [Subtitle]: 他們說的膠原蛋白 也只是幾個分子碎片 不是遺傳密碼本身. (12) [Subtitle]: 而且這些膠原蛋白 是骨頭裡面那幾條快化成粉的碎片 也不是皮膚的. (13) [Subtitle]: 像皮膚這種軟組織 本來就很難在化石裡面保留下來. (14) [Subtitle]: 那你連皮膚都沒看過 怎麼好意思說你做出暴龍皮革包勒. (15) [Subtitle]: 但這家公司其實還有另一個目的 除了裝酷之外 他們希望這顆暴龍包 能顛覆以往皮革包 殘忍殺生啊 或是化工造成的環境污染問題. (16) [Subtitle]: 不喜歡合成皮 就給你一個無法拒絕的理由. (17) [Subtitle]: 嗯 商人厲害. (18) [Subtitle]: 不過如果走在街上 真的拎著一顆說是暴龍包的東西 有人看得出來嗎. (19) [Subtitle]: 而且比起暴龍包 前男友皮是不是更有威嚇力一點呢. (20) [Subtitle]: 欸 抱歉抱歉 太職男了. (21) [Subtitle]: 買買買 都買. (22) [Subtitle]: 想了解更多科學新聞嗎 快點這裡.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a science commentary piece aimed at debunking the sensationalist claim that a company can create genuine T-Rex leather bags. It uses a blend of enthusiastic delivery and visual aids to explain the biological impossibilities (DNA degradation) and the actual commercial marketing strategy behind the product.
